method: anonymous CMR search (collections, granules.json granule_size, UMM-C, UMM-Var), Harmony /capabilities (anonymous), PO.DAAC open docs bucket (data dictionaries, MSS ATBD). No data granule downloaded: every data URL redirects to Earthdata Login (HTTP 302 urs.earthdata.nasa.gov), OPeNDAP DMR likewise (302 /login/urs).

collections.level: L2 per specular sample (25x25 km average of 1-5 DDMs)
collections.format: netCDF-4, one file per UTC day, all spacecraft
collections.notes: sample dimension = 1,020,707 in the UMM-Var reference file (time units 'seconds since 2018-08-11') - the only row count measured. MSS vars: mean_square_slope (float32, unitless, fill -9999), mean_square_slope_uncertainty, mss_sample_flags (bit1 fatal_composite = low<0 | high>1 | inc>65 deg | bin ratio; bit6 non-fatal preliminary GPS antenna knowledge). Also wind_speed (FDS, from the SAME NBRCS/LES observables), incidence_angle, fresnel_coeff, swh, swh_swell_sum (ERA5/GFS), range_corr_gain, sc_roll, spacecraft_num, sample_time, lat, lon. UMM DirectDistribution prefix says CYGNSS_L2_V3.1/ (stale); granule URLs use CYGNSS_L2_V3.2/.

collections.format: netCDF-4, one file per UTC day
collections.resolution: 0.2 x 0.2 deg, 24 hourly bins per file; lat 400 x lon 1800 (0.1..359.9)
collections.notes: variables: time, epoch_time, lat, lon, wind_speed, fds_rcg, wind_speed_uncertainty, num_wind_speed_samples, mean_square_slope, mean_square_slope_rcg, mean_square_slope_uncertainty, num_mss_samples. mean_square_slope = inverse-variance weighted mean of all L2 MSS samples in the bin; uncertainty = std of error of that mean (data dictionary 148-0351-5).

mss_definition.source: ATBD Level 2 Mean-Square Slope Retrieval, UM 148-0139 Rev 3 (2016-09-22), https://archive.podaac.earthdata.nasa.gov/podaac-ops-cumulus-docs/cygnss/open/L2/docs/148-0139-L2-MSS-ATBD-R3.pdf
mss_definition.formula: mss = |R(theta, eps(SST,SSS))|^2 / sigma0 at the specular point (geometric-optics Kirchhoff, isotropic Gaussian slope PDF, mss_x = mss_y = mss/2)
mss_definition.units: dimensionless (total slope variance of waves longer than an L-band cut-off; ~0.2 m wavelength - the 'L-band-filtered' MSS)
mss_definition.error: ATBD Tables: relative MSS error 1.2-2.5 % from Fresnel/geometry terms; sigma0 uncertainty 0.82 dB (U10<20 m/s), 0.70 dB above; GO and Gaussian-PDF assumptions may fail in hurricane cores
confounders: wind: MSS is first a wind measurement - L2 wind_speed is retrieved from the same NBRCS, so the CYGNSS wind cannot serve as the independent predictor
swell: total MSS = wind-sea + swell slopes (ATBD eq. 2.9); v3.2 corrects the WIND for swell, not the MSS
surfactants: natural biogenic slicks and oil damp short waves -> low MSS, the same signature the microplastic index reads
rain: ITCZ anomalies named in the microplastic collection's own caution
SST/SSS through the Fresnel coefficient (zonal-monthly 1x1 deg LUTs)
calibration: GPS EIRP / antenna gain (non-fatal preliminary_gps_ant_knowledge flag), range-corrected gain, spacecraft roll

tier_P.rows: one per L2 sample passing mss_sample_flags bit1 == 0
tier_P.rows_per_day_basis: UMM-Var sample dimension of one 2018-08-11 file (8 spacecraft); QC pass fraction NOT measured
tier_P.rows_per_year_estimate: 3.3e8-3.7e8 at that rate (7 vs 8 spacecraft); up to ~6.6e8 if 2024-25 L2 file growth (125 vs 70 MB/day) is rows - unverified
tier_P.bytes_per_row_analogue: 70-97 B/row measured for family-1 tier-P stores with 3 channels (swh 69.9, swot 97.4)
tier_P.fetch: whole L2 files: measured 26.9-45.8 GB/yr (2019-2025), 271.3 GB total; at 50 MB/s 9-15 min/yr, ~90 min total; Harmony variable subset would cut bytes (the [sample,5,4] per-DDM arrays dominate) - not measured

tier_G.grid: native L3 grid 0.2 x 0.2 deg, H=400 (-40..40) x W=1800, daily frames (F=5 per bin, 86400 s)
tier_G.source: CYGNSS_L3_V3.2 hourly bins combined to the day by inverse variance (w = 1/mean_square_slope_uncertainty^2 reproduces the IV daily mean exactly if the documented uncertainty is 1/sqrt(sum w))
channels: wind_speed (IV daily mean, for the confound only)
tier_G.fetch: measured L3 V3.2: 2.7-5.0 GB/yr (2019-2025), 29.4 GB total, 13.9 MB median per day; at 50 MB/s ~1.7 min/yr, ~10 min total
tier_G.alt: 0.25 deg daily from L2 (same 271 GB fetch as tier P) if the store must sit on family 7's grid

falsifiable_checks: F1 (producer reproduction): for 3 days, bin L2 V3.2 samples with mss_sample_flags bit1 clear into the L3 0.2 deg x 1 h cells with weights 1/mean_square_slope_uncertainty^2; num_mss_samples must match exactly in >=99.9 % of non-empty cells and mean_square_slope to <=1e-5 relative; and 1/sqrt(sum w) must equal mean_square_slope_uncertainty. If it fails, the hourly-to-daily IV combination of tier G is not exact and the store must be built from L2.

F2 (physics): MSS rises monotonically with an INDEPENDENT wind (not CYGNSS's own): Spearman rho >= 0.8 between daily 0.25 deg MSS and collocated reanalysis 10 m wind over 2019, wind-binned medians strictly increasing 3-15 m/s.
recommendation: tier G, native 0.2 deg daily from CYGNSS_L3_V3.2 (C2832196567-POCLOUD), 2018-08-01 -> present (+-40 deg), with F1 run on hosted runners before publishing. ~30 GB fetch, ~5-9 GB store; tier P would cost 25-65 GB/yr of store for samples the plastic question (1 deg / 30 day features) does not resolve.
